review_description: Quick response for a quote, equally quick and efficient installation- 3 years ago - ?? my solar savings!!
Great service no stress. Made it a pleasure to deal with in selection of system to suit my budget. Installation quick and efficient. Happy to recommend them all.

This is my first solar system after several years of deliberation.The quotation was sent through promptly along with detailed information about the installation process and projected power savings etc.The install crew arrived promptly and carried out the work very professionally, keeping me informed of any power disruptions etc. The quality of the work was excellent and everything was left clean and tidy on completion. (Ascend also organised the meter replacement through Synergy and they happened to turn up on the same day, so that worked out perfectly).The system is working perfectly and the app is really useful for monitoring power data.

Very pleased with the solar system from Ascend.The salesman was easy to relate to, friendly and funny. Made the effort to visit the site and give a live quote, showing the process in front of me.The actual install was swift, payment simple, and the quality of work was excellent - I haven't even found any broken tiles when they warned me it was all but guaranteed! The installers themselves were tidy, professional and communicated their needs and how the work would affect me at every stage. One of the installers took extra time to ensure the inverter monitoring was hooked up and working fully - even when my network was making it tough.Ascend provided a lot of assistance with applying to the retailer, and guided through the process of upgrading the meter and so on. For a first-timer, this was really helpful.About the only nitpick - and this is honestly scraping the barrel so hard I have splinters - is that the email correspondence was slow and not acknowledged, even if answers came in a call later.I did also ask for alternative panels, but was talked out of it. Later research suggested that the reasoning was misleading, but the system that was quoted and installed is highly satisfactory nonetheless.

Sales/quoting was thorough and very informative. All questions answered.Installation efficient, clean and tidyCustomer service: Everything was organised when I signed up. No problems. All connections made.Thank you for putting me on the right track.
The quoting process was efficient and professional. The consultant was respectful and  not pushy.
Original quote was too high and I had to bargain to get at a good price .Installers where Polite and kept me informed.

How was the sales/quoting process?> Had a professional electrical engineer visiting next day even though it is weekend.> Not pushy, slowly laid out all options using valid reasoning justifying their options.How did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?> It was raining that day. Despite all on and off drizzling, they have managed to install on time took them 4hrs (mainly due to rain)How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install?> excellent customer service, directly liaising with the company owner and installers.> Meticulously resolved all my questions and I was certain what I want to make decision

After researching for 18 months on all pros and cons and different suppliers, I sat down with Kane from Ascend and knew that this was the company I wanted to go with, they were approachable, were able to answer my questions without pushing a sale on me. We actually did a four house deal because my family members were so impressed with everything.Install day was fast once we accepted the offer, and they worked under the pump to squeeze us in before Christmas break.After sales has been great too so would not look any further then Ascend.

Very professional approach. These guys know solar.Well planned system.Install team were very efficient and friendly.Small problem with some ceiling damage was fixed and sorted to my satisfaction.3 storey house, 3 phase.Highly recommend ascend.

I had a very informative experience (salesman- Jason Maguire) with quoting to decide the best system for my home electricity usage. Additionally- the pricing was very reasonable and competitive.  My electricity bills are almost non existent. The installers were punctual and tidy. I couldn't be happier with the over all experience!
Very very very happy with Ascend Controls and Electrical Services and installers Western Fusion Electrical really nice guys and very professional  the best in Perth.
